mapper.sql: a.id, a.workspace_id, a.entity_type, a.entity_id, a.file_name, a.url, a.content_type, a.size, a.uploaded_by_id, a.created_at, a.updated_at, u.display_name AS uploaded_by_name
mapper.select:
SELECT , COALESCE(c.name, p.name, d.name, eu.display_name) AS entity_label
WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.entity_type = #{entityType} AND a.entity_id = #{entityId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT , COALESCE(c.name, p.name, d.name, eu.display_name) AS entity_label
WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT , COALESCE(c.name, p.name, d.name, eu.display_name) AS entity_label
WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.url = #{url} LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN a.content_type LIKE 'image/%' OR LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.file_name, '.', -1)) IN ('png','jpg','jpeg','gif','webp','svg','avif','bmp','ico','heic','heif','tif','tiff') THEN 'image' WHEN a.content_type = 'application/pdf' OR LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.file_name, '.', -1)) = 'pdf' THEN 'pdf' WHEN a.content_type LIKE '%spreadsheet%' OR a.content_type = 'text/csv' OR a.content_type = 'application/vnd.ms-excel' OR LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.file_name, '.', -1)) IN ('xls','xlsx','csv','tsv','ods') THEN 'spreadsheet' WHEN a.content_type LIKE '%presentation%' OR a.content_type = 'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint' OR LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.file_name, '.', -1)) IN ('ppt','pptx','odp','key') THEN 'presentation' WHEN a.content_type LIKE 'audio/%' OR a.content_type LIKE 'video/%' OR LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.file_name, '.', -1)) IN ('mp3','wav','ogg','flac','m4a','aac','mp4','mov','webm','avi','mkv','m4v') THEN 'media' WHEN a.content_type LIKE '%zip%' OR a.content_type LIKE '%compressed%' OR a.content_type LIKE '%x-7z%' OR a.content_type LIKE '%x-rar%' OR a.content_type LIKE '%x-tar%' OR a.content_type LIKE '%gzip%' OR a.content_type LIKE '%x-bzip%' OR LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.file_name, '.', -1)) IN ('zip','rar','7z','tar','gz','tgz','bz2','xz') THEN 'archive' WHEN a.content_type = 'application/json' OR a.content_type = 'application/xml' OR a.content_type = 'text/html' OR a.content_type LIKE '%javascript%' OR LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.file_name, '.', -1)) IN ('js','jsx','ts','tsx','json','html','htm','css','scss','py','java','go','rb','rs','php','sh','yml','yaml','xml','sql','c','cpp','cs','kt','swift','toml') THEN 'code' WHEN a.content_type LIKE '%word%' OR a.content_type LIKE '%opendocument.text%' OR a.content_type = 'application/rtf' OR a.content_type LIKE 'text/%' OR LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.file_name, '.', -1)) IN ('doc','docx','odt','rtf','txt','md','markdown','pages') THEN 'document' ELSE 'other' END

FROM attachment a LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = a.uploaded_by_id LEFT JOIN company c ON a.entity_type = 'company' AND c.id = a.entity_id AND c.workspace_id = a.workspace_id LEFT JOIN person p ON a.entity_type = 'person' AND p.id = a.entity_id AND p.workspace_id = a.workspace_id LEFT JOIN deal d ON a.entity_type = 'deal' AND d.id = a.entity_id AND d.workspace_id = a.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user eu ON a.entity_type = 'user' AND eu.id = a.entity_id

ORDER BY
a.created_at ASC a.file_name ASC a.size DESC a.created_at DESC
mapper.select: SELECT a.entity_type AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM attachment a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} GROUP BY a.entity_type
SELECT AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM attachment a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} GROUP BY `key`
SELECT att.tag_id AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM attachment_tag att JOIN attachment a ON a.id = att.attachment_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} GROUP BY att.tag_id

SELECT COUNT(*)
WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND COALESCE(c.name, p.name, d.name, eu.display_name) IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.size), 0) FROM attachment a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE att FROM attachment_tag att JOIN attachment a ON a.id = att.attachment_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND att.attachment_id = #{attachmentId} AND att.tag_id = #{tagId}
DELETE att FROM attachment_tag att JOIN attachment a ON a.id = att.attachment_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND att.attachment_id = #{attachmentId}
DELETE FROM attachment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
DELETE FROM attachment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId}
